description: Admin module - System health dashboard, user management CRUD, OCR monitor, storage stats, deduplication viewer, audit log, system settings, and banner management. Admin-only pages providing full system administration capabilities.
steps: Create src/lib/mock-data/admin.ts: Mock admin data including: system health metrics (DB status, Redis status, OCR queue depth, storage usage, uptime), user list (10+ users with all roles), audit log entries (50+ with various actions), OCR queue jobs (processing, failed, completed), storage breakdown by category, duplicate document groups, system settings

Create src/server/routers/admin.ts: Admin tRPC router (admin-only): getHealth (system status), getUsers/createUser/updateUser/deactivateUser, getOcrQueue/retryOcrJob/cancelOcrJob, getStorageStats, getDuplicateGroups/mergeDuplicates, getAuditLog (paginated), getSettings/updateSetting, getBanners/createBanner/deleteBanner. All guarded with adminProcedure

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/page.tsx: Admin Dashboard. PageFrame with PageHeader ('System Administration'). Service health cards row: Database (green/red), Redis (green/red), OCR Workers (status + queue depth), Storage (usage bar). Quick stats: Total Users, Active Sessions, Documents Today, OCR Jobs Today. Links to sub-pages

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/users/page.tsx: User Management page. Data table: Name, Username, Email, Role (badge), Department, Status (active/inactive badge), Last Login, Actions (edit/deactivate). Create User button opens form dialog. Role filter, department filter, status filter. Edit role via inline select or dialog

Create src/components/admin/user-form.tsx: User create/edit form. Fields: username, email, name, password (create only), role (select), designation, department, section, employee_id, phone, is_active toggle. Zod validation

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/health/page.tsx: System Health detail page. Real-time status cards for each service. Uptime counter. Response time history (chart). Active connections. Memory/CPU usage indicators. Auto-refresh every 30s

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/ocr/page.tsx: OCR Monitor page. Queue summary cards: Queued, Processing, Completed (today), Failed. Job table: Document, Status, Progress (pages processed / total), Started, Duration, Error (if failed), Actions (retry/cancel). Auto-refresh. Failed jobs highlighted

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/audit/page.tsx: Audit Log page. Searchable, filterable log table. Columns: Timestamp, User, Action (badge), Resource Type, Resource ID, IP, Details (expandable). Filters: action type, user, resource type, date range. Export. Shows hash chain integrity status

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/dedup/page.tsx: Deduplication page. Shows groups of duplicate documents (same file_hash or matching 3-point hash). Each group shows: file hash, count, documents in group (with metadata). Actions: Merge (keep one, link others), Keep All (mark as not-duplicate), View Differences

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/settings/page.tsx: System Settings page. Grouped settings: Work Types (editable table of categories/codes/target days), Agencies (list management), Document Categories, Max Upload Size, OCR Toggle, Maintenance Mode, Session Timeout. Save per section. Shows last updated timestamp

Create src/app/(protected)/admin/banners/page.tsx: Banner Management page. Create system-wide announcements. Fields: message, type (info/warning/critical), active toggle, start/end dates. Active banners shown at top of all pages
Create src/components/admin/health-card.tsx: Service health card with status dot (green/amber/red), service name, status text, response time, uptime percentage
Update sidebar navigation to include Admin section (visible only to admin role) with sub-links: Dashboard, Users, Health, OCR, Audit, Dedup, Settings, Banners
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: Admin Dashboard shows health status cards for all services
User Management supports CRUD operations with role assignment
OCR Monitor shows queue status with retry/cancel actions
Audit Log is searchable and filterable with expandable details
Deduplication page groups duplicate documents and offers merge actions
Settings page allows editing system configuration
Admin pages are only accessible to admin role users
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
